title: Irish Oat Casserole
description: A hearty and comforting casserole made with Irish oats and gooey cheese.
instructions: In a large pot, bring 4 cups of water to a boil.
Add Irish oats and cook according to package instructions.
In a separate pan, melt vegetable oil over medium heat.
Add brown sugar and cinnamon; stir until sugar dissolves.
Add cooked oats to the pan with sugar mixture and stir well.
Transfer oats mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Sprinkle gooey cheese on top of the oats mixture.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from oven and let cool for 5 minutes before serving.
